summary: This December 2025 Capital of Evil lecture is already-public support for Attention Capture and Secret Society: capital extracts attention through freedom, abstraction, debt, anxiety, and destroyed security, then becomes mobile transnational capital whose trust and agency-displacement machinery is secret-society coordination.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Capital is a mechanism for extracting human energy, attention, and focus, and managed freedom or equity can make that extraction more efficient than direct slavery.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The public Attention Capture page already uses this source as the definition anchor for capital as attention extraction.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Debt, poverty, war, depression, and wealth destruction make people anxious enough to return their attention to work.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The public Attention Capture page already uses this source for anxiety and destroyed security as focus discipline.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: When exploitation becomes too visible, the landlord class moves; transnational capital has no loyalty to nation, people, or place.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The public Attention Capture page already carries the mobile-capital anchor and links it to the trust problem that leads into Secret Society.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Secret-society ritual lets actors displace responsibility onto a higher power so they can do what they could not bear to do alone.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The public Secret Society page already uses this source for agency displacement through ritual authority.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Secret societies solve the practical trust problem created when mobile capital crosses places, identities, and jurisdictions.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The public Secret Society page already uses this source for secret societies as mobile-capital trust machinery.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Already public: keep this source as the definition spine for capital as attention extraction. The lecture supplies freedom/equity as managed agency, money as abstract God, anxiety as work discipline, destroyed security as renewed focus, and mobile capital as the landlord learning to leave.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Attention owns the capture of consciousness and focus. Power owns money as installed social reality; Debt owns obligation; Secret Society owns the extractor-group trust and ritual machinery.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Already public: keep this source as the Secret Society layer where mobile capital needs hidden trust, ritual displaces responsibility, authority/conformity overwrite ordinary psychology, and initiation turns members into dependent operators.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Secret Society owns hidden coordination, trust, ritual agency displacement, and initiation hierarchy. Attention owns capital's extraction target; Power owns institutional conversion of money, debt, and symbols into material force.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use as bounded Power comparison pressure only: money becomes a God-like abstraction, banking extracts energy across time and space, and private banks or companies turn public guarantees, monopoly, and national mythology into lived power.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Power should not absorb the whole lecture. The source's first active mechanism is attention extraction; Power receives the money/banking/symbol-to-reality layer when future compression needs it.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Hold as Debt comparison pressure: debt creates never-ending anxiety at the household level, while national debt and the Bank of England model make public repayment capacity guarantee private lending across time.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Debt owns obligation and repayment machinery. Attention owns the anxiety/focus effect; Power owns the alchemical conversion of money signs and guarantees into social reality.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use only as Platform Infrastructure relation pressure if that held surface later compresses front-end trust mechanics: Jiang extends the old agent model into tech firms, arguing that military-origin technology becomes acceptable when delivered through trusted private founders and free interfaces.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Platform Infrastructure is currently a held atlas/proposal surface, not a standalone public page. It owns public-private control surfaces and trusted fronts; Secret Society owns Jiang's hidden-control interpretation; Attention owns the focus-capture result.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Keep the closing World War III warning as a dated forecast-family input only: Jiang says the system will destroy the economy and start World War III to restore anxiety, focus, and work when wealth makes people complacent.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Prediction owns date, horizon, object, and later scoring. This intake should not convert the warning into a confirmed ledger claim or a standalone World War III page.

new_lens_seeds.title: Trauma Programming As Obedience Engine
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: Destroyed reality, dissociation, dependency, initiation, sex, drugs, and handler memory can be used to make a person obedient to the agent who arrives inside the wound.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: The lecture applies the pattern across Stockholm syndrome, Spartan education, gangs, cartels, child armies, Assassins, MKUltra, and secret societies, but the material is sensitive and currently better routed through Secret Society, Education, Human Heart, and Dead World boundaries than made public from one source.

chronology_notes.note: Dated 2025-12-09, this lecture is already one of the public origin layers for capital as attention extraction and for secret societies as the trust/agency-displacement machinery of mobile capital.
The source gives Jiang's four-stage merchant-oligarchy sequence: Venice, Dutch Republic, England, and America, with Protestantism and Enlightenment increasing capital abstraction and power.

Jiang dates the English transition through the 1688 Glorious Revolution and Bank of England charter, then reads parliamentary public repayment as the guarantee that lets private lending finance empire across time and space.
The lecture dates Bretton Woods to 1945 and Nixon's gold break to 1971, then closes with a dated 2025-12-09 future warning that economic destruction and World War III would restore anxiety and focus.

next_actions.action: No immediate public prose mutation is needed: Attention Capture and Secret Society already cite this source and preserve stable anchors for capital as attention extraction, anxiety returning focus to work, mobile capital without homeland, agency-displacing ritual, and mobile-capital trust.

No immediate episode-to-lens repair is needed: the read links to valid existing Attention and Secret Society anchors, including the atlas-level `lens-point:attention-capture-extracts-energy` and the concept-page `lens-point:capital-extracts-attention`.

If later synthesis follows, compare this source with existing Power, Debt, Dollar Hegemony, Platform Infrastructure, and Secret Society records before adding any money-as-God, Bank-of-England, offshore-capital, or tech-front paragraph to public pages.

Do not create standalone Capital Of Evil, Transnational Capital, Money Is God, Secret Societies, Satan, Saturn, Milgram, Solomon Asch, Stockholm Syndrome, Spartan Education, Assassins, MKUltra, Venice, Dutch Republic, Bank Of England, East India Company, British Money Laundering, Rockefeller, Carnegie, Federal Reserve, Freemason America, New World Order, or World War III pages from this source alone.
